ENGINEERING MANAGER | CLOUDOPS | DEVOPS | SRE | CI/CD

Bangalore, KA 560109 • 9040660409 • charansai.pondhuru@gmail.com

TARGET ROLES: SENIOR ENGINEERING MANAGER | DIRECTOR – CLOUDOPS/DEVOPS | HEAD OF SRE/

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Engineering Leader with 15+ years in CloudOps, DevOps, and, SRE, leading teams of up to

40+ engineers and delivering 99.99% uptime for global SaaS platforms.

Proven record in multi-cloud architecture, automation, and large-scale distributed systems,

delivering 30% cost savings and accelerating release cycles from weeks to hours. • Proven 8-year track record in engineering leadership, delivering large-scale cloud and

automation initiatives with measurable business impact.

Extensive expertise in DevOps practices and SRE principles, delivering high-availability,

resilient, and scalable systems.

Proficient in multi-cloud environments including AWS, GCP, Azure, and Oracle Cloud, with

hands-on experience in architecture, migration, and optimization.

Skilled in DevOps toolchains such as Git/GitHub, Jenkins, Docker, and Kubernetes for CI/CD

automation and container orchestration.

Experienced in enterprise monitoring and observability solutions including Datadog,

AppDynamics, Prometheus, and Zabbix for proactive incident prevention.

Recognized trainer and mentor in Oracle WebLogic, Cloud, and DevOps, enabling team

upskilling and knowledge transfer across global teams.

Strong leadership in strategic planning and governance, driving enterprise cloud strategy, IT

compliance, stakeholder alignment, and global delivery excellence.

PROFESSIONAL ACHIEVEMENTS

Delivered 99.9% uptime for critical production systems by implementing High Availability &

Failover strategies.

Architected self-healing infrastructure for 100+ Linux servers, reducing MTTR by 50% via

automated anomaly detection (Python + Datadog).

Spearheaded cloud migration projects and saved a lot annually in infrastructure costs. • Implemented CI/CD pipelines, reducing deployment time significantly.

CORE LEADERSHIP HIGHLIGHTS

Strategic Roadmap Execution: Led multi-cloud platform engineering across 4 clouds (AWS,

Azure, GCP, OCI), achieving 99.99% uptime for mission-critical retail SaaS products.

DevOps Transformation: Architected self-service CI/CD pipelines and IaC frameworks

(Terraform, Ansible, Helm) cutting infra provisioning time from 3 days to 45 minutes.

Global Team Leadership: Managed 35+ engineers across geographies, fostering a culture of

engineering excellence, agile delivery, and innovation.

• Cost Optimization: Achieved 30% annual cloud spend reduction through reserved capacity,

autoscaling policies, and resource rightsizing.

KEY PROJECTS

Scaled multi-cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure/OCI) for 2M+ users, achieving 99.99% SLA

via HA architectures and AI-driven observability.

Led OCI migration of 30+ client environments, delivering seamless transition with <2 hours

downtime and ensuring full compliance with security and performance SLAs.

Designed autoscaling policies for Kubernetes clusters handling 2B+ daily API calls.

CORE COMPETENCIES AND SKILLS

Cloud Tech Stack DevOps Tools Monitoring Tools Server Stack Leadership Skills Distributed Systems DevOps/SRE

AWS Cloud, Azure Cloud, Google Cloud and Oracle Cloud. Git/GitHub, Jenkins, Dockers and Kubernetes Datadog, AppDynamics, Prometheus and Zabbix. Oracle WebLogic, Apache Tomcat and Nginx Agile/Scrum, IT Governance & Compliance, OKR/KPI Development AWS EKS, GKE, AKS, Kubernetes, Istio Terraform, Ansible, Prometheus, Datadog, SLI/SLO frameworks

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Engineering Manager- DevOps/Cloud/SRE, Oracle – Bengaluru, India, 04/2017 to 09/2025

Principal Technologist, Oracle – Bengaluru, India, 10/2014 to 04/2017

Senior WebLogic Administrator, CGI – Bengaluru, India, 06/2009 to 10/2014

KEY PROJECTS AND ROLES:

ORACLE – GLOBAL BUSINESS UNIT – SAAS APPLICATIONS

Develop, maintain and administer tools which will automate operational activities and

improve engineering productivity.

Mentored and upskilled team of 35+ engineers across DevOps, SRE and Cloud adoption.

Developing configuration and infrastructure solutions for internal deployments.

Working with Kubernetes/Docker containers.

Manage systems on OCI infrastructure including application servers, database servers.

Researched and resolved complex issues discovered during Migrations.

Manage high availability of existing systems and proactively address system maintenance

issues.

Manage OCI infrastructure configurations along with Application Load Balancers, HTTPS

configuration.

Managing 50+ Linux servers & component provisioning & handling configuration &

deployment of infrastructure & services.

Managed the infrastructure, avoided single point of failure, monitored RAM CPU space

Virtualisation & Load Balancing.

• Created server & components by application of Virtualisation Concept using Docker.

• Employed HAProxy to conduct load balancing for handling a constantly increasing user base &

ensuring scalability & reliability Cloud Based Distributed Computing.

Implemented CI/CD pipelines across diverse tech stacks, enabling zero-downtime deployments

and cutting release cycles from weeks to hours.

Pioneered Infrastructure-as-Code adoption with Terraform, Ansible, and Kubernetes

Operators, accelerating infrastructure provisioning by 70%.

Drove DevOps practices embedding security scanning, compliance checks, and automated

rollbacks into every build and release pipeline.

CGI – BANKING DOMAIN

Day to day operation of WebLogic platforms like restart, monitoring, etc.

Deployment of applications into servers.

Apache-Web Logic plugins configurations.

24X7 support provided for the infrastructure of Prod/DR/PRE-PROD.

Installation of WebLogic server and Apache web servers.

Communicating with the client, Testing Team & Development Team.

Configuring WebLogic resources like JDBC data source, connection pool.

Fine tuning of various application/web server environments.

Performed root cause analysis and implemented corrective actions.

Designed and incorporated process design improvements.

Troubleshot issues with websites and fixed scripting and use issues.

Proved successful working within tight deadlines and fast-paced atmosphere.

Carried out day-day-day duties accurately and efficiently.

EDUCATION

Bachelor of Technology – Electronics and Instrumentation – JNTU, Anantapur (2005 – 2009)

Recognized for driving AI-powered operational improvements.

For successfully delivering 20+ cloud migration.

Certified Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Architect – Associate

Certified Oracle WebLogic Administrator – Associate
